title: Bad Request
message: One or more parameters are invalid or missing.
cause: A required parameter such as q was omitted, or a value failed validation (for example an unsupported country code).
resolution: Check the parameters table for the endpoint and confirm all required fields are present and correctly typed.

title: Unauthorized
message: The request could not be authenticated.
cause: The Authorization header was missing, malformed, or contained an invalid API key.
resolution: Confirm the Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY> header is present on every request once authentication is enabled.

title: Forbidden
message: The API key is valid but not allowed to access this resource.
cause: The current plan does not include access to this endpoint or feature.
resolution: Upgrade the plan or remove the restricted parameter from the request.

title: Not Found
message: The requested endpoint does not exist.
cause: The request path was misspelled or uses a version that is no longer available.
resolution: Double check the endpoint path against the API Reference section of these docs.

title: Too Many Requests
message: The request was rejected due to rate limiting.
cause: The number of requests sent within the current window exceeded the plan's rate limit.
resolution: Slow down request frequency, add backoff/retry logic, or upgrade to a higher plan.

title: Internal Server Error
message: Something went wrong while processing the request.
cause: An unexpected failure occurred on the server while handling an otherwise valid request.
resolution: Retry the request. If the problem persists, it is safe to assume the issue is on our end, not the request.
